name: KDK First Drawing
intro: Join our first learning contest! Enter your email below and watch for the winner announcement on our YouTube channel.
rules:
1. One entry per person using a valid email address.
2. No purchase necessary.
3. Winner will be selected randomly and announced on our YouTube channel.
4. By entering you agree to receive contest-related emails only (we never spam).
5. Contest open to residents of the United States who are 18+.
6. We reserve the right to update these rules at any time.
successMessage: You're entered! Watch our YouTube channel for the winner announcement.
